categories.main_business_segments: Shenyang Fortune Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the semiconductor equipment precision components sector. Its main product lines include mechanical and electromechanical components (such as chambers, liners, gas distribution plates, heating plates, vacuum valve bodies, and modules) and gas transmission systems (including gas cabinets and pipelines). These products serve semiconductor manufacturing equipment, covering processes like etching, thin film deposition, photolithography, ion implantation, and chemical mechanical polishing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mechanical manufacturing, specialized surface treatment technologies, and welding processes including electron beam welding, laser welding, vacuum brazing, and ultra-clean pipeline welding. It has developed proprietary coating technologies such as dense YO coatings, N/O series films, and Al-F composite films to enhance corrosion resistance and cleanliness. Manufacturing methods include high-precision micro-hole and deep-hole processing, ultra-high surface finish, and one-stop large cavity machining, supported by intelligent manufacturing systems and modular design.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international semiconductor equipment manufacturers, including top-tier global semiconductor equipment companies and major Chinese semiconductor equipment firms. The company serves the integrated circuit industry and other semiconductor-related sectors, providing components critical for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes. Its customer base includes both domestic clients in China and overseas clients in the US, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant revenue from the Chinese mainland, accounting for approximately 70% of its business. It also has a growing international presence with operations and customers in the US, Singapore, Japan, Malaysia, and Taiwan. Production facilities and subsidiaries are located in Shenyang, Nantong, Beijing, and Singapore, supporting both domestic and global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fortune Precision operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and assembly of precision components and modules for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. It provides critical parts and integrated gas transmission systems that are upstream inputs for semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation in precision manufacturing, surface treatment coatings, and welding technologies to support advanced semiconductor process requirements. It invests heavily in R&D to develop high-density, corrosion-resistant coatings and complex component manufacturing capabilities. Strategic priorities include expanding high-value product lines, enhancing intelligent manufacturing, accelerating overseas market penetration, and pursuing vertical integration through acquisitions to strengthen the semiconductor equipment supply chain.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized precision components and gas transmission system products to semiconductor equipment manufacturers. The company operates on a direct sales model, with pricing based on material costs, process complexity, and market competition, tailored to customer equipment types and requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fortune Precision is a leading domestic player in the semiconductor equipment precision components market, recognized as a core supplier to global semiconductor equipment leaders. The industry is characterized by high technical barriers and fragmented suppliers, with international competitors mainly from the US, Japan, and Taiwan. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive manufacturing capabilities and advanced surface treatment technologies, positioning it as a key enabler of semiconductor equipment localization in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.04 billion, representing a 47.14% year-over-year increase, driven by strong semiconductor market demand and domestic localization trends. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 202.65 million, up 20.13% from the previous year. The company has shown robust growth with expanding production capacity and improving profitability, supported by increased R&D investment and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fortune Precision emphasizes its comprehensive precision manufacturing capabilities, advanced surface treatment technologies, and integrated gas transmission system solutions as key differentiators. Its products meet or exceed international standards for cleanliness, corrosion resistance, and precision, enabling customers to reduce supply chain complexity and improve procurement efficiency. The company’s intelligent manufacturing and modular design approach provide high adaptability and rapid response to evolving semiconductor process requirements, supporting customers’ advanced technology development and localization needs.
